name: guardyourphone
description: GuardYourPhone: a phone security check-up with twice-daily restart reminders.

scripts.cap:android: npm run core && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#0b1620' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0b1620' --splashBackgroundColor '#0b1620' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0b1620' --android && cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run core && cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#0b1620' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0b1620' --splashBackgroundColor '#0b1620' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0b1620' --ios && cap sync ios
